verdict.rationale: Tailscale provides webhooks for tailnet events and supports infrastructure-as-code/API automation (tailscale-docs-12, tailscale-docs-18), which lets external systems react to events, but there is no first-party rule engine that itself defines conditional triggers and actions — the actual automation logic must be built externally. missing for 10: a native rules/trigger-action engine, documented examples of end-to-end automated workflows, independent confirmation of webhook reliability.
